nodes.rationale: Behaviour functions cannot be serialized from a Server Component to AgRuntime; a thin 'use client' wrapper owns that boundary instead of marking the whole page client, cutting route / from 20.5 kB/123 kB to 8.72 kB/111 kB First Load JS.

nodes.rationale: Chained .replace() calls re-mangled each other's inserted {'{'} output; replaced with a single-pass replacer function. Real templates contain zero braces, so only the synthetic test covers it.

nodes.label: Converter Completeness Guard

nodes.label: Whole-String Equality Assertions
nodes.rationale: Substring/regex checks can pass while nearby output is corrupted (the brace bug still matched the original regex); assert.equal on the whole fragment cannot.
